select id, code, name, merge_code from bm_material where is_deleted = 0 and is_sub_material = false
and status = 1
and material_category_id = #{materialCategoryId}
order by merge_code asc
select m.*,c.category_type from bm_material m left join bm_material_category c on m.material_category_id = c.id where m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.id = #{id}
select m.*,c.category_type from bm_material m left join bm_material_category c on m.material_category_id = c.id where m.is_deleted = 0

select distinct t1.*,t2.id as process_id from bm_material t1 left join bm_process t2 on t2.product_id = t1.id where t1.is_deleted = 0 and t2.id in
#{id}
